description: Ground truth for the reading-passage extractor. Each lesson was checked against rendered PDF pages (pdfs/ folder) and the PDF text layer. Pages are 1-based PDF page indices (the convention used by texts.page_number), not the printed page numbers.

matching_rules.key: Text is compared on a key that keeps only letters and digits (NFC, Latin look-alike capitals mapped to Greek, soft hyphens removed, case kept). first_words/last_words must be the start/end of the stored content.
matching_rules.lines: For poems, the stored content must have exactly `lines` non-empty lines and `stanzas` blank-line-separated groups.
matching_rules.window: Every DB row of this source whose page_number is inside the window must match an expected or optional passage, otherwise it is a false positive.
matching_rules.optional: Optional passages are real texts that are embedded in an exercise or have no title. They may be absent (no false negative) or present with correct boundaries (no false positive).
matching_rules.forbidden: Exercise/instruction text from the window. No row of this source may contain it.
matching_rules.global_forbidden: Text that must not appear in any row of the whole database.
